name: VAMSI MANNE
title: ==QA ANALYST — FUNCTIONAL · REGRESSION · INTEGRATION TESTING==

sections.heading: SUMMARY
sections.body: ==QA Analyst / Test Engineer== with 6+ years of hands-on software testing experience ==designing, planning, and executing functional, regression, and integration testing== for enterprise web applications. ==Prepares and maintains comprehensive test plans, test cases, test data, and workflow matrices==; manages the ==defect lifecycle== from identification through resolution using Jira and Azure DevOps; and ==supports release validation and UAT with business stakeholders==. ==Translates complex business rules into high-coverage test cases== across SaaS commerce, CRM, customer-service and government platforms. ==Proficient in SQL for backend data validation== and in API testing with Postman and REST Assured; strong analytical, edge-case testing and cross-functional communication skills.

sections.note: FILL-IN — the JD's headline requirement is ETRM/CTRM (commodity trading) exposure. The resume shows no trading-platform work: [ETRM/CTRM] and [OpenLink Endur] are placeholders and this role is a stretch without them. If you can speak to trade-capture or settlement-adjacent workflows (e.g., billing, entitlement, subscription settlement), frame them honestly in an interview, but do not add them to the resume.
